cellacdc/shared/workers.doc:
Workers used by several program parts.

- base.py: the worker infrastructure (worker_exception_handler,
  workerLogger, signals) and the generic workers (SimpleWorker,
  CustomPreprocessWorkerGUI, ...). A foundation leaf: it imports no dialog,
  widget, gui or utils module, so every worker module can import it at
  module level.
- saving.py: saveDataWorker, the save worker of the main GUI, also used by
  the Compute measurements utility.

Workers of one program part live in that part: <part>/workers.py, for the
main GUI gui/workers/<theme>.py. Utility workers live in their
utils/<utility>.py, BaseWorkerUtil in utils/base.py, and the workers whose
names clash with utility window classes in utils/segm_workers.py.

This package re-exports nothing: import its modules.

cellacdc/gui/workers.doc:
Workers used only by the main GUI window (guiWin and its gui/main_window
mixins), by theme:

- loading_saving.py: loading Positions and frames, undo states, autosave.
- segmentation_tracking.py: repeat segmentation, promptable models,
  tracking, post-processing and segmentation edits.
- annotation_checks.py: the cell cycle annotation integrity checker.
- image_processing.py: preprocessing and combining channels, saving their
  images.

The measurements viewer never uses these modules (the viewer-shared
gui/mixins use only SimpleWorker from shared/workers/base.py). The save
worker of the main GUI, saveDataWorker, is in shared/workers/saving.py.

This package re-exports nothing: import its modules. Names of the former
workers.py module reached through the import path of this package are
forwarded by the compat layer with a deprecation warning.

cellacdc/shared/workers/base.py.doc:
Shared worker infrastructure and generic workers.

worker_exception_handler decorates the run method of every worker.
workerLogger and the signals QObject are the logging/progress signals of
QObject workers, also used by utility workers and the CellACDC_2steps
tracker. SimpleWorker runs a function in a QThread.
CustomPreprocessWorkerGUI is the queued preprocessing job base subclassed by
gui/workers/image_processing.py and measurements_viewer/workers.py.
ApplyImageFilterWorker, ScreenRecorderWorker (record.py) and AutoPilotWorker
are generic workers without static users.

Foundation leaf: this module imports no dialog, widget, gui or utils module,
so any module can import it at module level without an import cycle.

cellacdc/shared/workers/saving.py.doc:
saveDataWorker, the save worker of the main GUI: segmentation masks,
acdc_output tables (measurements, cell cycle and custom annotations) and the
other per-Position files.

guiWin.saveData builds it with the main window itself; the Compute
measurements utility (utils/compute.py) builds it with its headless main
window. The worker reads guiWin attributes, so its host is always a guiWin.

cellacdc/gui/workers/loading_saving.py.doc:
Main GUI (guiWin-only) workers that load data and store state:
loadDataWorker (loads Positions), LazyLoader (loads frames in the
background), StoreGuiStateWorker (undo states) and AutoSaveWorker (periodic
autosave of the annotations).

The save worker of the main GUI, saveDataWorker, is in
shared/workers/saving.py.

cellacdc/gui/workers/segmentation_tracki.doc:
Main GUI (guiWin-only) workers that segment, track and edit masks:
segmWorker and segmVideoWorker (repeat segmentation of a frame or a video),
MagicPromptsWorker and MagicPromptsSegmStackWorker (promptable models; the
latter subclasses segmVideoWorker), LabelRoiWorker, SegForLostIDsWorker,
trackingWorker, relabelSequentialWorker, PostProcessSegmWorker, and the
segmentation edit helpers FindNextNewIdWorker, CopyAllLostObjectsWorker and
DelObjectsOutsideSegmROIWorker.

cellacdc/gui/workers/annotation_checks.p.doc:
Main GUI (guiWin-only) cell cycle annotation integrity checker:
CcaIntegrityCheckerWorker checks the cell cycle annotations in the
background while the user annotates.

cellacdc/gui/workers/image_processing.py.doc:
Main GUI (guiWin-only) workers for preprocessing and combining channels:
CombineChannelsWorkerGUI (a subclass of CustomPreprocessWorkerGUI in
shared/workers/base.py), and SaveProcessedDataWorker and
SaveCombinedChannelsWorker, which save the preprocessed and the
combined-channel images.

cellacdc/data_prep/workers.py.doc:
Data prep module workers: AlignDataWorker (aligns the frames),
DataPrepSaveBkgrDataWorker (saves the background data), DataPrepCropWorker
and MoveTempFilesWorker. Used by data_prep/main_window.py.

cellacdc/data_structure/workers.py.doc:
Data structure workers: CreateSymLinkToPosWinWorker creates the symlinked
Positions of the CreateSymLinkToPosWin window in
data_structure/data_struct.py.

These workers use worker_exception_handler of shared/workers/base.py, which
emits (worker, error) on the critical signal of the worker and of its
signals object. data_struct.py defines a different worker_exception_handler
for its own bioFormatsWorker, which emits only the error on the worker's
critical signal: never mix the two.

cellacdc/launcher/workers.py.doc:
Launcher workers: MigrateUserProfileWorker moves the user profile folder to
a new location (the launcher action in launcher/main_window.py imports this
module inside the function that starts it).

cellacdc/utils/segm_workers.py.doc:
Workers of segmentation-file utilities that cannot live in their utility
module.

CreateConnected3Dsegm, Stack2DsegmTo3Dsegm and FilterObjsFromCoordsTable
have the same names as the utility window classes in
utils/createConnected3Dsegm.py, utils/stack2Dinto3Dsegm.py and
utils/filterObjFromCoordsTable.py. Those modules use them as
segm_workers.<Name>, never through a from-import, which would rebind the
window class name. ApplyTrackInfoWorker is shared by
utils/applyTrackFromTable.py and utils/applyTrackFromTrackMateXML.py.

notes: Coverage: all 66 non-import top-level statements of cellacdc/workers.py at 4c4e498b are mapped (64 classes, 1 function, the assignment DEBUG). The old file becomes a split shim in C7 (shard moves).

Placements follow the workers design (abb7651a98255d6ef) with synthesis R13: AutoPilotWorker -> shared/workers/base.py (the design had data_prep/workers.py; autopilot is also used by guiWin). MeasurementProcessingWorkerGUI -> measurements_viewer/workers.py, a module created and documented by the viewer shard (it also receives _ThreadTaskWorker); it must exist from C7 on (measurements_viewer package from C3).

DEBUG (unused flag, not on the plan delete list) -> shared/workers/base.py, so that the compat table can resolve the old name cellacdc.workers.DEBUG. The design wanted it only as a plain attribute of the compat module, which the shard format cannot express.

The commented-out _correctAcdcOutput block (old lines 7421-7474) is indented inside ComputeBackgroundValuesWorker and moves with it to utils/computeBackgroundValues.py; update the comment in background_values.py that points to workers.py.

Name clashes: utils/createConnected3Dsegm.py, utils/stack2Dinto3Dsegm.py and utils/filterObjFromCoordsTable.py define window classes named like their workers. The rewriter must emit `from . import segm_workers` + `segm_workers.<Name>` there, never `from .segm_workers import <Name>`.
Utility workers moved into their own utility module are then referenced by bare name there (`workers.X(` -> `X(`); BaseWorkerUtil comes from utils/base.py (relative, same part).

Packages: this shard creates cellacdc/shared/workers and cellacdc/gui/workers (C7). The parent packages cellacdc/shared (widgets shard, C5) and cellacdc/gui, data_prep, data_structure, launcher, measurements_viewer (moves shard, C3) must already exist at C7.

gui/workers/__init__.py and measurements_viewer/workers.py shadow the old attributes gui.workers and measurements_viewer.workers (the old workers module imported as `workers`): the compat layer adds forwarders for old workers names there (synthesis section 3).

Function-local relative imports that change meaning with the new depth (move.py recomputes them): SegForLostIDsWorker.run `from . import regionprops` (-> cellacdc.regionprops), MigrateUserProfileWorker `from . import models_path` and `from . import user_profile_path_txt` (-> cellacdc). The absolute local imports (roifile, spotmax, cellacdc.service.client, cellacdc.promptable_models, cellacdc.promptable_models_path) are unaffected.

Implicit submodule loading (fixups, optional): SegForLostIDsWorker uses skimage.segmentation, which workers.py never imported (another module loads it); add an explicit `import skimage.segmentation` in gui/workers/segmentation_tracking.py. `from .utils import resize` is needed only by ResizeUtilWorker (utils/resize/util.py: `from .. import resize`). `measurement_processing` is then imported only by viewer modules: the main GUI no longer triggers processor discovery, which it never used.
Unused imports of workers.py that no destination needs: h5py, plot, measurements and the duplicate `core` import are dropped by the import recomputation.

record.py (unimportable today: level-2 relative imports from a top-level module) uses workers.ScreenRecorderWorker; leave it untouched and allow-list it in the import tests, or fix all three imports to level 1 and use shared/workers/base.py.

References outside code to update (C12-C15): CellACDC_2steps tracker annotation (line 81, evaluated at def time) and docstring (line 109) `cellacdc.workers.signals` -> shared/workers/base.py; docstrings in background_values.py (lines 5, 267), apps.py (~20182), lineage_tree_integrity.py (~96), service/model_execution.py (7), tests/related_tests.py (80), tests/test_background_values.py (2); docs model-environments.rst (153); CLAUDE.md (utility pattern: worker in utils/<name>.py, BaseWorkerUtil in utils/base.py).

Tests that reference moved workers: test_segm_utils, test_gpu_availability (SegForLostIDsWorker), test_box_prompts_gui (MagicPromptsWorker), test_lineage_tree_reset (AutoSaveWorker, trackingWorker), test_keep_ids (trackingWorker), test_background_values (ComputeBackgroundValuesWorker, class-level monkeypatch of _processPosition), test_apply_recipe_last_frame and test_measurement_processing_viewer (MeasurementProcessingWorkerGUI; issubclass check against shared CustomPreprocessWorkerGUI), test_set_measurements_selection (ComputeMetricsWorker, saveDataWorker).

Aliases of the utility modules that receive workers or dialogs (alias only, set by the integration step): utils_<module> (utils/resize/util.py: utils_resize_util), the alias plan_check derives; the widgets shard pins utils_base, utils_fromImageJroiToSegm and utils_generateMothBudTotalTable the same way. Existing local names (utilsCompute, ...) are rewritten to these in C12/C13.
